title: Explorer Guide: Modular Microtips & Overlay Artifacts for First‑Run Console Tour
creator: Priya Raman
description: Create a modular set of microtips, screenshot overlay artboards, and empty‑state illustration variants for the Console first‑run tour. Deliverables will include: 1) microcopy pack with 3 tone variants (friendly, concise, enterprise), 2) 10 overlay PNGs (desktop + narrow layout), 3) 6 scalable vector empty‑state illustrations with color/mono variants, 4) a sticker sheet for product marketing to annotate screenshots, and 5) Figma handoff page with tokens and export-ready slices. Goal is to provide assets for the guided checklist panel, the 'no routes yet' empty state, step tooltips, and the quickstart checklist cards. Emphasis on modularity so PMs can toggle tone/complexity per customer tier. Include accessibility contrast checks, localization-ready copy slots, and a small QA checklist for engineering integration.
acceptance_criteria: Figma page 'Explorer Guide / Handoff' contains all artboards and export presets for SVG and 2x PNG
Microcopy CSV with three tone variations and translator notes attached to the Figma file
All overlay assets exported at 1x and 2x; naming follows the console asset convention (overlay_<component>_desktop.png)
Empty‑state illustrations have high-contrast variant and 3 color palettes (brand, neutral, low-contrast) documented
Design tokens (spacing, color, radius) documented and approved by frontend lead
At least one engineer testing pass with screenshots integrated in staging with no visual regressions

notes: Accessibility: ensure tooltip contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for body text; provide ARIA labels for each overlay element.
Localization: allow 20% expansion for DE/FR strings; avoid hard-coded line breaks in illustration callouts.
Motion: include recommended 120ms fade for tooltip entrance and 80ms scale for checklist reveal (documented in Figma prototype).
Design tokens: use --space-xs / --space-sm / --radius-1 tokens to keep overlays compatible with current CSS system. Document token fallbacks for Private deployments.
Fallbacks: provide vector and raster assets; engineering will prefer SVG for empty-state illustrations but needs PNG for server-side screenshotting.
